overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation where the Chair limited a member of the public's participation in public comment, because the chair controls who may speak. The AG declined to review the allegation against Town Counsel, who is not a member of a public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that at the Board's May 18 meeting the Chair denied a member of the public the ability to participate in the public comment portion.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Open Meeting Law gives the chair of a public body discretion over who may speak or otherwise participate at a meeting, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that Town Counsel also violated the Open Meeting Law in connection with the May 18 public comment limitation.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law only applies to public bodies and their members. Individuals who are not members of public bodies are not subject to the Open Meeting Law, and we therefore decline to review any allegation that Town Counsel violated the Open Meeting Law.
